info.name: Advance Request Mobile API (السلفة)
info.description:
Mobile flow for employee salary advance (سلفة) requests.

== THE POLICY DROPDOWN ==
The "available advances" dropdown in the create-request screen is fed by request #1 (GET /my/advance-policies). It returns ONLY the advance policies assigned to the logged-in employee, each with its LIVE availability (no types, no yearly balances — availability is computed on the fly, no reset). Use "name" as the dropdown label (recommended: show "max_amount" next to it, e.g. "سلفة طارئة — up to 5,000") and submit that item's "advance_policy_id" when creating the request (#2). Items with can_request=0 must be DISABLED (remaining_slots=0 means the employee already has the maximum number of active advances under that policy). Policies the employee is NOT assigned to will never appear here — assignment is done by HR from the user profile (web).

== FLOW ==
1) GET /my/advance-policies → fill the dropdown (also gives per-policy limits: max_amount, max_installments, requires_attachment, remaining_slots, can_request)
2) POST /advance-requests with the chosen advance_policy_id → request enters the approval workflow (auto-approved instantly if the company has no approval steps configured)
3) GET /advance-requests/my → track status (pending قيد الانتظار / approved مقبول / rejected مرفوض / cancelled ملغي)
4) GET /advance-requests/{id} → details incl. workflow.in_progress + rejection_reason
5) POST /advance-requests/{id}/cancel → cancel while still pending (owner only) — frees the policy slot immediately

== NOTES ==
- NO types and NO yearly balances: availability = pending + approved requests count vs the policy's max_active_advances. Rejected/cancelled requests free the slot right away; approved ones keep counting until repaid (repayment is handled outside this API).
- Response envelope: { "code", "message", "payload" } (+ "pagination" on paginated lists).
- Errors: 422 with { "message" } for business-rule failures (policy not assigned, amount over max, installments over max, missing required attachment, active-advance cap reached) — display "message" to the user.

Headers: Authorization: Bearer {{auth_token}}, X-Tenant: {{tenant_id}}, Accept: application/json, Accept-Language: {{language}}

request.description: THE DROPDOWN SOURCE. Returns the advance policies ASSIGNED to the authenticated employee with live availability. Map each item: dropdown label = "name" (+ "max_amount"), submitted value = "advance_policy_id". Per selected policy adjust the form: requires_attachment=1 → show upload field; amount input max = max_amount; installments input max = max_installments; can_request=0 → disable the item (remaining_slots=0).

request.description: Creates the request for the authenticated employee using the advance_policy_id picked from the dropdown (#1). The approval workflow starts immediately: if the company configured approval steps, status stays "pending" (workflow.in_progress=true); otherwise it is auto-approved. On 422, display the returned "message" (policy not assigned / amount over max / installments over max / missing required attachment / active-advance cap reached).

request.description: Cancels a PENDING request owned by the authenticated employee. Any open approval steps are closed and the policy slot is freed immediately (remaining_slots goes back up in #1). Errors: 422 if not pending, 403 if not the owner.
